title: Continuous Subarray Sum
statement: Return true when `nums` has a contiguous subarray of length at least 2 whose sum is a multiple of `k`. A multiple includes 0. `k` is at least 1.
hints: Equal prefix remainders mark a multiple, but the two prefixes must be at least two indices apart.
Store the first index of each remainder.
Seed remainder 0 at index -1 so a prefix that itself is a multiple of length at least 2 is detected.

approaches.name: All subarrays
approaches.explanation: Test every range of length at least 2.

approaches.name: First remainder index
approaches.explanation: Stop when the same remainder is at least two steps old.

editorial: If prefix[j] and prefix[i] share a remainder and j - i >= 2, the subarray (i, j] has length at least 2 and a sum divisible by k. Record a remainder only the first time you see it, so the gap is as large as possible. The seed (0, -1) handles subarrays that start at index 0.
